form.aiSavedKeyNeeded: Saved. The AI coach works once the matching API key is present in the server environment.
form.annualDerived: Annual figure is derived from this
form.apiKeyHint: API keys are never stored here. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENROUTER_API_KEY or AI_API_KEY in the server environment.
form.baseUrlHint: Only for self-hosted or compatible endpoints
form.bulkAssignHint: Assigns a course to everyone in a department or job family. Employees already enrolled are skipped.
form.certificateRuleHint: What an employee must complete before a programme certificate is issued.
form.columnOrderHint: Column order does not matter and extra columns are ignored. Only the first three are required.
form.coursesImportedUnverified: {created} created ({queued} sent to the review queue), {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped. Left unverified: run Courses → Needs review before they reach anyone's path.
form.coursesImportedVerified: {created} created ({queued} sent to the review queue), {updated} updated, {skipped} skipped. The rest are live in the catalog and available to the recommendation engine.
form.entryLevelHint: The level this path is written for
form.executiveReportHint: A leadership-ready PDF: readiness index, participation, level distribution, department analysis, skill improvement, opportunities and risks.
form.explanationHint: Shown after the assessment, so learners understand why
form.heatmapHint: Average competency score by department. Blank means nobody in that department has been assessed yet.
form.historyHint: Records learning completed before the academy existed, so hours and passports start from the truth.
form.importCoursesSubtitle: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV — a provider export, or your own catalog spreadsheet
form.importSkipHint: Rows marked INVALID or DUPLICATE are skipped. A course whose code already exists is updated, not duplicated.
form.jobFamilyHint: Job families drive role matching in the recommendation engine. They are fixed in code because courses, capstones and role modules are mapped to them.
form.linkCheckFailed: The automated check could not reach this course ({count} of {limit} attempts failed). After {limit} it is withdrawn from the catalogue and stops being recommended.
form.measuredOnly: Only if measured — never estimated by the system
form.orgSubtitle: Departments, sections, job titles and locations
form.pathFamilyHint: Leave empty for a path open to every role. A path with families set is only offered to those families.
form.peopleImportHint: Rows with an unknown department are not imported. Unknown job titles, locations and managers are imported with that field left empty.
form.peopleImportSkipHint: Rows marked INVALID or DUPLICATE are skipped. Existing employees are updated, not duplicated.
form.pipelineNote: Approved workplace capstones become the company's AI transformation pipeline.
form.poolHint: How many questions to draw from each competency and difficulty. Questions are picked at random per attempt.
form.promptRubricHint: Graded against the prompt rubric (context, objective, constraints, output, verification) and always flagged for human confirmation.
form.question: Question
form.questionArchiveHint: A question already used in an attempt is archived rather than deleted, so history stays intact.
form.readinessMethodHint: Each component is scored 0–100 and multiplied by its weight. Skill improvement treats a 40-point gain between the baseline and the latest assessment as a full score. Weights are configurable in Settings.
form.recurringHint: Training that has to be done again. The scheduler assigns it each time it comes round, including the first.
form.reminderDedupeHint: Duplicate unread reminders are never created, so a rule cannot spam an employee.
form.schedulerOff: The in-application scheduler is off. Run `npx tsx scripts/run-jobs.mts` from cron, or use the button above.
form.schedulerOn: Running inside the application. Jobs are checked every 15 minutes and each one runs on its own interval.
form.smtpHint: The password is read from SMTP_PASSWORD. Until SMTP is enabled, password-reset links are written to the server log instead of being emailed.
form.smtpSaved: Saved. The SMTP password is read from the SMTP_PASSWORD environment variable.
form.structureRemoveHint: Removing a module or lesson also removes the learner progress recorded against it.
form.targetLevelHint: Where a learner should end up
form.targetingHint: These fields drive the recommendation engine. A course with no department or job family is treated as general-audience content.
form.technicalFlagHint: The technical flag decides whether an employee is ever offered technical content.
form.technicalQuestionLabel: Technical question (never shown in the general corporate assessment)
form.tempPasswordHint: At least 10 characters. Everyone imported must change it at first sign-in.
form.tempPasswordSet: A temporary password has been set: {password}
form.title: Title
form.trustedSourceHint: Tick this for a provider's own catalog export, where the links are as reliable as any you would click through yourself. Leave it clear for a scraped or hand-assembled list: those rows stay out of every recommendation until someone opens the link. Either way, your choice is recorded in the audit log against your name.
form.trustedSourceLabel: These links come from a trusted source — mark them verified
form.unknownValues: Values not found in the system
form.verificationHint: External providers change their courses. Recording a review resets the “needs review” flag.
form.weightsHint: Component weights. The methodology is shown next to the index, so these numbers are visible to anyone who can see the dashboard.
form.withdrawnFromCatalog: Withdrawn from the catalogue — the link has failed every check. Fix the URL and the next check puts it back.
